title: pleopeltis onoei
intro: Pleopeltis onoei, commonly known as the Japanese polypody or kondei, is a type of epiphytic fern native to East Asia. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Pleopeltis onoei include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antioxidant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. These bioactive constituents work together to provide the plant's medicinal properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
